contact.basis: Fixed native north approach ground endpoint before every floor/section/geometry choice. Provider-relative independent bank datum, unsurveyed; not fitted to bridge or support geometry.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Big Four Bridge frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.12.5m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Urban source relief may contain building/canopy artifacts and does not resolve tower foundations or exact doorway thresholds. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
